constraints.name: creation_authority_associatio_network_key_tx_hash_inclusio_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (network_key, tx_hash, inclusion_hash, actual_creation_record) REFERENCES ops_admission_v2.creation_births(network_key, tx_hash, inclusion_hash, actual_creation_record) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: creation_authority_associatio_network_key_tx_hash_seed_dig_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (network_key, tx_hash, seed_digest) REFERENCES ops_admission_v2.creation_capture_coverage(network_key, tx_hash, seed_digest) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: creation_authority_associations_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (kind = 'WALLET'::text AND wallet_actor IS NOT NULL AND factory_root IS NULL OR kind = 'FACTORY'::text AND wallet_actor IS NULL AND factory_root IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: creation_authority_associations_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (network_key, tx_hash, inclusion_hash, actual_creation_record, seed_digest, planned_entry)

constraints.name: creation_authority_refs_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (kind = 'WALLET'::text AND wallet_actor IS NOT NULL AND wallet_org IS NOT NULL AND witness_id IS NOT NULL OR kind = 'FACTORY'::text AND wallet_actor IS NULL AND wallet_org IS NULL AND witness_id IS NULL)

constraints.name: creation_authority_refs_network_key_tx_hash_plan_digest_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (network_key, tx_hash, plan_digest) REFERENCES ops_admission_v2.creation_plans(network_key, tx_hash, plan_digest) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: creation_births_network_key_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (network_key) REFERENCES ops_admission_v2.creation_observer_state(network_key) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: creation_births_observed_at_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (isfinite(observed_at) AND observed_at >= '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone AND observed_at < '10000-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)

constraints.name: creation_capacity_network_key_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (network_key) REFERENCES ops_admission_v2.network_state(network_key) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: creation_capture_coverage_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (isfinite(probe_finished_at) AND probe_finished_at >= probe_started_at AND probe_finished_at <= (probe_started_at + '00:00:02'::interval))

constraints.name: creation_capture_coverage_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (isfinite(valid_until) AND valid_until >= probe_finished_at AND valid_until <= (probe_finished_at + '00:00:05'::interval))

constraints.name: creation_capture_coverage_network_key_tx_hash_seed_digest_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (network_key, tx_hash, seed_digest) REFERENCES ops_admission_v2.creation_authority_refs(network_key, tx_hash, seed_digest) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: creation_capture_coverage_probe_started_at_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (isfinite(probe_started_at) AND probe_started_at >= '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone AND probe_started_at < '10000-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)

constraints.name: creation_headers_network_key_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (network_key) REFERENCES ops_admission_v2.creation_observer_state(network_key) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: creation_observer_state_capture_heartbeat_until_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (capture_heartbeat_until IS NULL OR isfinite(capture_heartbeat_until) AND capture_heartbeat_until >= '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone AND capture_heartbeat_until < '10000-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)

constraints.name: creation_observer_state_check4
constraints.definition: CHECK (NOT capture_ready OR ready AND quarantine = 'none'::text AND capture_heartbeat_until IS NOT NULL AND known_tip_number = head_number AND known_tip_hash = head_hash)

constraints.name: creation_observer_state_last_confirmed_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (last_confirmed IS NULL OR isfinite(last_confirmed) AND last_confirmed >= '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone AND last_confirmed < '10000-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)

constraints.name: creation_observer_state_lease_expires_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (lease_expires IS NULL OR isfinite(lease_expires) AND lease_expires >= '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone AND lease_expires < '10000-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)

constraints.name: creation_observer_state_network_key_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (network_key) REFERENCES ops_admission_v2.network_state(network_key) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: creation_plans_network_key_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (network_key) REFERENCES ops_admission_v2.creation_capacity(network_key) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: creation_work_network_key_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (network_key) REFERENCES ops_admission_v2.creation_capacity(network_key) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: work_finite_attempt
constraints.definition: CHECK (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR isfinite(next_attempt_at) AND next_attempt_at >= '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone AND next_attempt_at < '10000-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)

constraints.name: revoked_creation_capture_epoc_network_key_capture_epoch_wi_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (network_key, capture_epoch, witness_tx_hash, witness_seed_digest) REFERENCES ops_admission_v2.creation_capture_coverage(network_key, capture_epoch, tx_hash, seed_digest) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: revoked_creation_capture_epochs_revoked_at_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (isfinite(revoked_at) AND revoked_at >= '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone AND revoked_at < '10000-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)
